message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a well seal kit. Candidate headings are 3926.90 (other articles of plastics), 8481 (taps, valves), and 8421. A well seal or well cap that seals a well casing is mainly a plastic closure, so 3926.90.99 is the most likely. I recall a ruling that classified a similar product in 3926.90.9990 (Other articles of plastics, other). The product is a kit, but the plastic plates are the essential character component. 3925.90 (builders' ware of plastics) is another option, but it covers items like doors, windows, shutters, and fittings, and a well seal doesn't fit it well. I went with 3926.90.9990, using the current statistical suffix 3926.90.9990 (later changed to 3926.90.9990 for "Other").

{"hts_code": "3926.90.9990", "reason": "The well seal kit is a set of plastic compression plates with a rubber gland and fasteners, with essential character from the ABS plastic components, so it falls under other articles of plastics, n.e.s.o.i."}
